name: Humanizer
summary: Agent skill that rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer, removing chatbot patterns without changing meaning.
description: A SKILL.md package for AI coding agents that edits prose to strip AI tells: staged importance, rhythm by rule, triads and dashes, and other default choices a language model makes. It keeps what the text says and adds nothing. Install with npx skills add blader/humanizer.
contains: rewrites AI-sounding text without changing what it says
names patterns: staging, rhythm by rule, triads and dashes
install with npx skills add blader/humanizer
